LFG candidate: four foundation catalogues are implemented and locally verified in the clean integration checkout. The64-table total is the full proposal; application-reference conversions and the remaining60tables are pending. Nothing here claims a live schema change.

Global shared schema · completed design

PROPOSED · PLAN ONLY. 959 existing/pending string positions have physical design dispositions. 54 reopened chart positions remain deferred. No application code, migration or database was changed by this review. G2 leads integration; contributor acknowledgements and bounded handovers remain pending.

325 remodeled positions · 240 checked internal choices · 377 justified text/scalars · 12 existing-FK compatibility positions · 5 possible later removals. These describe original field positions, not net text-column removal.

64 proposed new tables, zero mandatory table retirements. 167 existing/pending source table names plus64 would yield231. The peer G2/G3 additions are already included in167. Four tables form the initial foundation; the other60 have separate purposes and release boundaries. No new JSON columns.

64 proposed tablesPhysical field decisionsCanonical planField CSVTable CSVEarlier review history

Settled behavior

Countries and jobs

Company: one nullable HQ-country FK. Person: supported citizenship rows, normally one; no invented default country. Job: several supported categories within each of six separate classification dimensions.

Languages

App edition: zh-Hans. Source zh-CN and bare zh remain distinct. Reuse shared Language/Locale references and owned label/translation rows; preserve exact historic hash inputs and source wording.

Historical X values

Include observed values by default with coverage qualification and actual contributing-release counts. Missing is never zero; no recall multiplier. Drained pagination, persisted Posts and complete enrichment are separate facts.

Migration route

One integration lead, small compatible candidates: additive storage, mapped values and compatible callers, cutover, then separately verified retirement. Isolated PostgreSQL and staging precede each separately authorized production release. Staging never overwrites production data.

64 proposed table owners

Every card names the proposed columns, ownership gap and constraints. Design phases group dependencies; they are not single release batches.

definition_versions · immutable definition

One immutable retained identity/version of a named method, prompt, workflow, taxonomy, query pack or other installed definition

Proposed column / type
id UUID PK
definition_domain varchar(64) NOT NULL
definition_key varchar(128) NOT NULL
reported_version_token varchar(256) NOT NULL
identity_sha256 char(64) NOT NULL
content_sha256 nullable char(64)

source_path nullable text

Constraints: UNIQUE(identity_sha256); checked domain/provenance states and hash/commit/locator grammars; append-only identity/meaning. Unknown historical bodies remain explicitly identity-only.

collection_observations.error_codetyped_diagnosticerror_code_kind + reported_error_code

14f8200b16f52963536c3da4e2c6046a6c130917c66775c3099ef0d3e70257bd

Earlier first-pass and strict-review evidence · superseded where final physical decisions differ

HISTORICAL AUDIT. Counts, ownership statements and unresolved proposals below describe earlier snapshots. Use the current physical ledger and canonical plan above for the final design.

Global CharField and TextField audit

FIRST-PASS REVIEW · NOT AN IMPLEMENTED SCHEMA. G2 leads; G3 retains collection implementation ownership. Owner reports G3 backfill halted. Catalogue/choice and source-preservation rules are owner-approved; distinct-definition naming and atomic scoped claims are also approved.

1,013 unique table/column positions across main, G2 dossier, G3 working schema and the ChartEngine proposal. This is source inventory and triage, not proof that every field is defective or design-reviewed. Inherited abstract fields are expanded per concrete table.

Strict 428 reviewFindingsG3 mapG2 dossierGlobal namesEntire DBOriginal inventory
Exact scope, counts and provenance

Main64b95c26:151models/502Char/305Text. G2 dossier2daeb735:158models/516Char/325Text. G3 dirty0093–0107:160models/598Char/327Text. Chart proposal:9tables/50Char/4Text. These overlapping variants are not one deployed database. G3 direct declaration count593Char in135classes matches the handoff; inheritance explains the expanded count.

Source only: no live database/value census, schema mutation, provider call, scheduler control or deployment. Framework-owned auth tables are outside this application-model inventory. CSV preserves source path, line and hash; main is recoverable from commit64b95c26.

Source-grounded findings

Timezones

Confirmed repeated concept; shared catalogue candidate

`metrics.source_timezone`, `metric_values.source_timezone`, `events.source_timezone`, `opportunities.source_timezone`, `event_dossier_claims.event_timezone`, `collection_corrections.before_source_timezone` and `after_source_timezone`, plus both proposed chart timezone fields.

No TimeZone model exists in inspected schemas. Propose one shared IANA-identifier catalogue and FK references, with unknown represented explicitly and never coerced to UTC. Preserve source wording/legacy hashes and reviewed alias mapping; a fixed UTC offset is not a timezone catalogue. The exact new catalogue definition and integration rollout remain to be settled.

Languages and locales

Repeated text across labeling, extraction, evidence and UI

`post_type_labels.lang`, other label-table `lang` fields, `posts.lang`, translation `source_language`/`target_language`/`locale`, `people_names.language`, `people_texts.language`, `people.primary_language`, `editorial_editions.locale`.

No shared Language/Locale model exists in inspected schemas. Review one shared catalogue with separately meaningful language and locale references. Do not equate UI locale configuration with the complete source-language universe. Retain raw provider tags where provenance requires them; map existing UI aliases without rewriting old evidence.

Metric definitions and units

Existing shared identities should be reused

Existing `metric_types` and versioned `metrics`; proposed `chart_series.metric_key`, `unit`, `quantity_form`, and copied `chart_metric_inputs.source_*` definition fields.

Replace independently editable chart metric codes with existing metric-type/source-metric references where semantics match. Derived line transformations remain explicit. Definition-owned metadata should be derived from the exact immutable definition version rather than another editable copy. Existing readers compare a pinned definition snapshot and reject changes, so FK-only replay requires proven version immutability; retain a specifically justified snapshot until that guarantee exists. No existing Unit model was found; a shared unit catalogue is a candidate, not an approved addition.

Actor, method and policy identity

Text can conceal identities and independently versioned definitions

`event_dossier_reviews.actor`, `method_version`, `ranking_method`; `event_dossier_claims.extraction_version`; `collection_corrections.actor_identifier`/`policy_version`; `taxonomy_versions.reviewed_by`, `metric_collection_contracts.reviewed_by`, `source_subject_mappings.reviewed_by`; provider/model fields on processing records.

Resolve whether an actor is a human, agent or system identity before choosing a shared record; an auth-user FK alone cannot represent all three. Scope method/version identifiers to a named method family and preserve the exact implementation/configuration version. Do not equate inference provider model names with tracked release Product identities. No new actor/method registry is selected without the required owner answers.

G2 dossier claim meaning and scope

High-priority schema-contract gap

`event_dossier_claims.claim_kind` and TextField `scope_key`; `event_dossiers.event_kind`; release `release_channel`/`availability_state`/`disclosure_state`; `personnel_change_details.change_kind`.

The claim writer stores supplied kind/scope in its hash and validates timezone; tests use announcement/x and repository_created/repository. That does not establish an authoritative shared claim vocabulary or the meaning/cardinality of scope. Owner selects one claim per channel/region availability fact; use explicit existing references for that scope and share source evidence. Review event/release classifications as business vocabularies. Review/disposition codes are separate from release availability; never merge their shared word “unknown.”

G2 dossier source wording and narrative

TextField is sometimes the correct evidence representation

`assertion_text`, `source_excerpt`, `reason`, `display_title`, `observed_name`, `native_identifier`, `version_label`, `variant`, `observed_person_name`, `from_organization_name`, `to_organization_name`, `from_title`, `to_title`.

Verbatim assertions/excerpts/reasons and authored titles can remain prose. Resolve identities separately through existing Product, Person, Company and affiliation links without erasing source wording. Existing `roles` classifies accounts (official/researcher/executive), not exact employment titles: do not force title strings into it. Model variant/version/native identity require their own cardinality and namespace review; they are not automatically display prose.

G3 execution, coverage and reasons

Same spelling does not prove one vocabulary

`collection_jobs.state`; `collection_runs.status`, `execution_state`, `coverage_state`; scope admission/execution/coverage/outcome; `collection_attempts.outcome`/`stop_reason`; `collection_requests.transport_outcome`; observation processing outcome; metric-gap/correction reason codes.

Trace transition writers and reports, then share a definition only where meaning and allowed transitions match. Execution completed, request received and coverage complete are distinct facts. Shared code choices with DB constraints are the owner-approved representation for internal states. Business-managed reasons/classifications may warrant domain-scoped catalogue rows. No universal status table is proposed.

G3 kinds, request coordinates and opaque evidence

Separate selected dimensions from source tokens

Target kind/role/resolution, request group/config/category, input role, resource kind, archive media_type/encoding, `collection_job_targets.membership_run_reference`, provider revisions, ETags, cursors and row locators.

Inspect actual consumers: request config/category/group can be analytical dimensions; input roles are relationship semantics; cursor/ETag/provider revisions/row locators are opaque evidence and may remain text. `membership_run_reference` needs a specific referent or preserved external namespace, not an arbitrary string-to-FK conversion. Keep exact request/resource/observation distinctions and existing evidence archives; never move operational fields into retained JSON.

Existing geography and relationship registries

Concrete reuse targets outside ChartEngine

`companies.hq_country`, `people.nationality`, job/opportunity currency fields, `accounts.source_query_ids`, `account_post_appearances.source_query_ids`, `posts.source_query_id`, `content_pictures.content_kind`/`content_id`.

Country/Region and SearchQuery already exist. Inspect whether each field is source text or canonical identity and whether nationality or query membership is one-to-many. Do not replace a plural string with a single FK. External post/reply IDs can refer to uncollected records and need not become invalid mandatory FKs. Polymorphic content IDs need an explicit target contract. No new shared country/query table is needed.

Temporal strings, hashes and scalar values

A field-type audit also catches non-catalogue modeling

`people.date_of_birth`; affiliation start/end strings; event/opportunity start/end/open/close values; `posts.created_at_raw`; revision hashes, identity keys and brand accent colors.

Review temporal strings together with precision and source wording; never fabricate a missing date component. Raw timestamps and exact provider tokens can remain preserved evidence alongside typed values. Hashes and validated colors are scalar data; repeated values alone do not justify entity tables. Renaming TextField to CharField is not a normalization fix.

Shared references need immutable or version-pinned meanings for historical replay. Genuine prose and source-native tokens can remain text with explicit reasons. Do not create a universal status table or swap strings for JSON.

Timezone standards: IANA identifier theory and Python ZoneInfo.

Strict-review precedence: for the 428 reviewed main fields, use the strict dispositions and updated CSV; these supersede older family-level HTML descriptions below.

Approved decisions and exact G3 naming map

Shared catalogue references for business values; checked internal states; preserve reported wording plus resolved references. Different definitions get different descriptive names. One EventDossier claim represents one channel/region availability fact.

Naming collision: model_release_details.release_channel currently means stable/preview/beta. Recommend release_maturity_id for this definition and access_channel_id for API/downloadable-weights access. CollectionRun.status remains a mixed legacy result while execution and coverage keep distinct names.

Strict review of the 428 tentative text survivors

These counts supersede the first-pass keep-text tally. Scope is exactly 428 fields present on main 64b95c26; proposed chart and pending-only fields are excluded. Source/model meanings and representative caller groups were inspected. No model, migration or live data changed. Full caller census and physical migration design remain separate implementation work.

428 exact field dispositions, evidence and preservation requirements · Frozen original 428-field bucket

Strict resultFields
Keep justified text/scalars290
Remain text as checked choices5
Already paired with existing Account FKs; native compatibility/evidence12
Reference shared definitions/values44
Move fixed-language values into locale rows (including 4 frozen snapshots)27
Reuse existing relationships; remove redundant projection7
Redesign packed facts or planner cursor identity13
Retirement candidates requiring caller/data proof5
Explicit owner/referent design still open25

290 + 5 = 295 remain text under this recommendation; the 12 compatibility fields are separate. Neither 44 references nor 27 locale moves means 71 deleted strings: reported evidence may remain, and translated wording remains text in child rows.

Confirmed corrections: provider verification/type/display-kind values and internal versions are not prose. Planner brand_id can be *, and cursor query_id carries a call key. Official-company scan cursor can contain a serialized cohort; listing locations are joined plural data. Existing translated text/name/subject tables provide reuse targets. Some native X IDs already have SQL FKs and compatibility triggers.

Five new locale-table candidates emerge from this slice: Brand labels, Company labels, Account profile-text translations, OriginalContent frozen subject labels, and TrendNarrativeSubject frozen labels. These are owned translation/snapshot tables, separate from shared lookup catalogues. Exact integration can reduce that candidate count; no final global lookup-table count is claimed here.

Entire database: field review coverage

The shared-definition and distinct-name rules now have a recorded recommendation for all 1,013 unique CharField/TextField positions across main, sister G2, G3 and the chart proposal. This expands beyond the 147 / 34 / 141 focused maps. Family recommendations are labelled: coverage is not proof that every field has a settled physical design or that the full schema is implementation-ready.

All 1,013 field recommendations · Every concrete core table, including tables with no direct text fields

Table coverage is 151 main + 158 G2 + 160 G3 model variants (469 overlapping entries; 167 unique table names). Framework/auth internals, URLField/EmailField subclasses, JSON/arrays and existing text-backed FKs are not counted as literal CharField/TextField declarations; the supplemental coverage below addresses those boundaries separately. No live database mutation has run.

Other database text boundaries

The literal CharField/TextField count also has 24 unique URLField positions (72 overlapping schema entries). These have the same shared-meaning review; retain validated source locators rather than inventing a URL vocabulary. Exact field map and provenance.

  • Existing foreign keys with textual target keys are already relationships. Review their target identity and historical mutability; do not replace them with duplicate string fields.
  • Existing JSON/arrays remain separate source boundaries. This audit proposes no new JSON/JSONB column; the G3-approved JSON retirements remain under G3 ownership. Serialized memberships inside TextField are still relationship candidates.
  • Tables with no literal string fields are listed in the table-coverage CSV. Their typed columns and references remain subject to ownership and shared-definition review.
  • Django/auth/framework tables retain framework-owned identity and enum contracts; application actor records may reference them but must also represent agents and systems.
  • This is a source-schema audit. A later read-only deployed-schema reconciliation must identify migration drift, unmanaged tables, generated columns and external writers before migration execution.

G3 implementation return map

  1. Existing shared identity/metric/subject/mapping relationships stay authoritative. Align timezone and temporal vocabulary choices with G2’s global decisions.
  2. Keep admission, request transport, execution, processing, coverage and stop outcomes distinct. Review exact transition writers and report filters before sharing choices.
